dataList.content:
We had a rather spirited start to this investigation, but our journey to the kitchen was far from straightforward.
出发时有精神是好事，但我们前往厨房的旅程并不容易。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Corridors
呼啸山庄 走廊

dataList.content:
Odd... from what I recall, turning right here should have led us to the first floor.
奇怪……我印象里在这里右转就能到一层的。

No. We should have found the kitchen ages ago.
不。要是去厨房的话，我们早就应该找到了。

And Nelly, it makes absolutely no sense that you of all people would be lost here.
而耐莉，你会在这房子里迷路这件事本身……就是不可能的。

Indeed. You could blindfold me and I would still know where everything in this house is.
的确。明明就算闭上眼睛，我也对这里所有房间的位置了如指掌。

This feels quite familiar. It is like...
这种感觉十分熟悉。就像……

The corridor.
……走廊。

... Indeed, like the corridors of the Backdoor.
面对巴士后门里的走廊时，也是这种感觉。

Yes. Considering the exterior of the manor and comparing it to its internal map, its shape and size is far from being even remotely reasonable.
是的，从外观和实际地图比较而言，这座宅邸早已脱离了原本的理论构造而存在。

<What's on your mind, Heathcliff?>
<你在想什么，希斯克利夫？>

This feels familiar. Like it's all just one big riddle Cathy used to give me.
这感觉很熟悉。就像曾经凯茜出给我的谜题一样……

I'd sometimes get the right answer early in the game. And every time I did, she kept making the answer more and more convoluted, annoyed that I actually managed to get it right.
我也有很快找出答案的时候，那种情况下她就会千方百计地把答案复杂化来刁难我。

This... is exactly what that felt like. Like she's cross with me, hiding the basement from us, making us go in circles...
现在的感觉也……好像她是在捉弄我似的。让我们找不到地下室……让我们在宅邸之中迷路……

Darnit, lemme see the diary. I wanna see if it says anything else about the basement.
哎呦！让我看一眼日记，看看上面有没有提到更多关于地下室的事。

This is like the third time we're walking through this hallway, 'kay? I'm starting to lose my cool.
这已经是我们第三次穿过这段走廊了吧？我快疯了。

Look! That picture frame again! Oh, I could recognize you from anywhere now!
那个相框！我都快对它产生感情了……

There wasn't anything else in the diary, lass.
那日记本上也没什么别的啊？

Just lemme have a look, Heath. What if you missed something?
就给我看一眼吧，希斯。万一是你看漏了什么呢？

EEAAUGH!
噫欸欸欸！

... Was that overreaction really necessary, Don Quixote...?
……没有必要这么大叫吧？堂吉诃德小姐……

What... the heck... was that?
那是……什么？

Hm. A window shattered, quite literally, out of nowhere.
嗯。一扇玻璃窗毫无征兆地被打碎了。

Aww, my bad, Heath. I dropped the diary. That noise really got me.
啊啊啊……对不起，希斯。那声音吓得我不小心把日记掉在地上了。

Don't bother. I just need to dust it lightly...
没事。把灰尘拂掉就行……

Wait. This page wasn't here earlier.
等等，刚才是没有这一页的。

Huh, you're right. That page was one of those ink stained pages, wasn't it?
真的啊，我记得这页之前被墨渍覆盖了……

XX/XX
X月X日

The basement.
地下室。

We... must descend there.
我们必须……下到地下室里去。

In a not so far future, I would like to hang my portrait at the entrance of that basement.
在不远的将来，我想把自己的肖像挂在这地下室的入口处。

A portrait of my most beautiful, most spirited... yet fleeting present self.
一幅定格了我最美丽、最活泼的一刻，定格了我此时此刻的姿态的，肖像画。

In those rare days when Josephine wasn't haunting that area of the manor, I'd sit there for hours with him by my side. Just chatting our day away...
在那些约瑟芬不在宅邸的珍贵的日子里，我就会独占那个地方，和他聊很长、很长时间的天……

Do you remember those days?
你还记得那些日子吗？

This is a riddle, isn't it...? So where could this be?
这是个谜题吗……？那是在哪儿？

If this is her riddle, then the only one who can solve it has to be...
能解答这谜题的人……肯定只有……

The entrance of that basement... just chatting our day away...
地下室的入口……曾经聊天的地方……

Heathcliff briefly closed his eyes as if to recall what these could be referring to... then squinted them open.
希斯克利夫短暂地闭上双眼，似乎在回忆所指代的地点……然后睁开了眼睛，向下方看去。

The fireplace in the dining hall.
是餐厅的壁炉。

Catherine enjoyed chatting with me before the fireplace.
凯瑟琳喜欢在壁炉前和我交谈。

... I see.
……原来如此。

Those moments must have been very precious to her.
那些瞬间对她而言，一定弥足珍贵。

Precious enough to write about them in her diary, so that she will always remember them.
足以让她记录在日记之中，以长久铭记。

You lot again.
又是你们……

dataList.content:
Any further attempts to communicate with them appear futile. They're clearly—
他显然是个无法交流的对手。再费口舌毫无意义……

No... the Dead Rabbits, they...
不……死兔帮是……

Heathcliff stopped himself, then scratched his head. He sighed deeply.
希斯克利夫想说些什么，又抓挠着脑袋深深地叹了一口气。

Dammit... I suppose it doesn't matter what I've got to say.
妈的……我知道无论说什么……都毫无意义。

I don't know. None of this feels real.
我不懂，所有的一切都难以置信。

They're saying that Cathy is dead... the Dead Rabbits have changed... and this bloody maze of a manor...
据称死掉的凯茜……面目全非的死兔帮……还有这座变成迷宫的可恨宅邸……
